description: First Credit and Investment Bank Limited is an investment bank and a joint venture of the National Bank of Pakistan and the Water and Power Development Authority, licensed by the SECP to provide investment finance services under the NBFC Regulations. It lends to commercial and industrial borrowers through syndication and direct financing against mortgage, hypothecation and receivables, runs a treasury and money-market book, and holds equity and debt investments. On the advisory side it arranges debt and equity, handles mergers and acquisitions and corporate restructuring, and provides feasibility studies and financial modelling.
headOffice: 2nd Floor, Sidco Avenue Centre, Stratchen Road, R.A. Lines, Karachi 74200, Pakistan

products.name: Fund-based operations
products.summary: Short- and long-term finance for capital expenditure and working capital, largely through syndication and against mortgage, hypothecation and receivables.

products.name: Treasury and money market
products.summary: A separate treasury division making short-term placements from the company's own resources and investing in equity and non-equity instruments.

products.name: Investment banking and advisory
products.summary: Debt and equity arrangements including TFCs, sukuk, IPOs, rights issues and private placements, plus project financing, mergers and acquisitions, restructuring, feasibility studies and financial modelling.
